items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It was Cecil Mack and Johnny Johnston Jones who introduced the Charleston in Running Wild... [INTERVIEWEE] Uh-huh, well, Running -- yes, I remember Running Wild well.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. See, I left, went to Europe in '25, I think, my first trip.
It was Cecil Mack and Johnny Johnston Jones who introduced the Charleston in Running Wild, a show called Running Wild.

Uh-huh, well, Running -- yes, I remember Running Wild well. Let me see. Cecil Mack, you know, collaborated with Eubie Blake in writing a lot of his music, because he wrote -- oh, I remember the first record that was made with a choir. I made it with a fellow named Elkins, and he had a big choir behind him.
